data.name: HeliosNetworkHeatmap_Desc
data.value: Shows the records of a view as tiles coloured by a numeric column, with paging, sorting and click-through.

data.name: Substations_Desc
data.value: The view or subgrid whose records become tiles.

data.name: HeatValue_Desc
data.value: The numeric column that sets each tile's colour, such as Customers Count.

data.name: TileLabel_Desc
data.value: Optional text column shown on each tile. The record's primary name is used when not mapped.

data.name: PageSize_Desc
data.value: How many tiles to load per page.

data.name: SelectedSubstationSchema_Desc
data.value: Hidden. Carries the output object schema for canvas apps.

data.name: SelectedSubstation_Desc
data.value: The tile the user last selected, as an object with id, name and heat value.
